speak.title: Role-play: should the shop charge for returns?
speak.setup: Work in pairs. Read your card, then have the conversation. Swap roles and do it again.

a.text: You run a small clothes shop online. Too many parcels come back and you're losing money. You want to charge a fee for returns. Explain why, and listen to your customer.

b.text: You often order two sizes and send one back. You don't want to pay a fee. Say why returns matter to you and suggest another way to cut the number of parcels.

phrases: I'm afraid we can't afford free returns any more.
I'd rather pay a small fee than lose the service.
That's fair, but I can't try anything on first.
What if we improved the size guide?
I'd be happy to keep ordering if the fee stays low.
speak.after: Afterwards, tell the class: did you agree on a fee, and was it fair?
